description: This file handles AJAX requests related to the Detail View of a module in the vtiger CRM system. It processes actions such as updating entity information and loading related lists, responding with success or failure messages.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A class providing methods to manage CRM entities, including instantiation for a specific module.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves and populates entity information based on record ID and module context.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current state of the entity object back to the database.
